location.title: Montijo, on the Tagus
location.lede: A riverside town on the south bank of the Tagus estuary, across the water from Lisbon. AKSA Residencies sits on the north-east edge of town in Esteval, beside the Av. D. João II roundabout: parks, schools and supermarkets within a 10-minute walk, the old town and riverfront 20–25 minutes on foot, and fast road links to the Vasco da Gama Bridge.
